sentences.en: They left home to join the caliphate and took an oath of allegiance to a terrorist group intent on destroying the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们离开家园加入哈里发国，并向一个旨在消灭美国的恐怖组织宣誓效忠。

sentences.en: Now they want to come home.
sentences.zh: 现在他们想回家了。

sentences.en: What should the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国应该怎么做？

sentences.en: do with the American wives of ISIS fighters?
sentences.zh: 如何处理 ISIS 战士的美国妻子们？

sentences.en: Friday, February 22nd.
sentences.zh: 2月22日，星期五。

sentences.en: Rukmini Kalamaki, tell me about getting to this detention center.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼·卡拉马基，跟我讲讲去这个拘留中心的经历吧。

sentences.en: So I've been in Syria at this point for almost three weeks.
sentences.zh: 当时我在叙利亚已经快三个星期了。

sentences.en: And we woke up early and we drove about two and a half hours to the northeast of the country.
sentences.zh: 我们很早就醒了，开车向东北方向行驶了大约两个半小时。

sentences.en: And there, there's a sprawling refugee camp where thousands of people are being held in a pseudo-detention state.
sentences.zh: 在那里，有一个庞大的难民营，成千上万的人被关押在一个准拘留状态中。

sentences.en: And we got out and we explained that with the New York Times, we had an appointment to come there.
sentences.zh: 我们下车后解释说我们是《纽约时报》的，我们预约好来这里。

sentences.en: And they asked us to go into a small room where there was a heated furnace and a couple of chairs.
sentences.zh: 他们让我们进了一个小房间，里面有一个烧得正旺的火炉和几把椅子。

sentences.en: So we waited in this room for more than an hour.
sentences.zh: 我们在那个房间里等了一个多小时。

sentences.en: I was starting to get nervous because I was told that the camp closes down at around three.
sentences.zh: 我开始紧张了，因为有人告诉我营地大约三点左右就会关闭。

sentences.en: And it was, I think, close to two when suddenly I heard a commotion outside.
sentences.zh: 当时我想快到两点了，突然我听到外面一阵骚动。

sentences.en: And I walked out and I saw two women.
sentences.zh: 我走出去，看到两个女人。

sentences.en: They were wearing the full burqa, the full face covering black veil that is typical of the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 她们穿着伊斯兰国典型的全套布卡长袍，也就是遮住全脸的黑色面纱。

sentences.en: But they were speaking fluent English with an American accent because they were American.
sentences.zh: 但她们说一口流利的英语，带着美国口音，因为她们是美国人。

sentences.en: So I invited them into the room where I had been sitting.
sentences.zh: 所以我邀请她们进我刚才坐的那个房间。

sentences.en: And at that point, they flipped back their niqabs, their face veil.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她们掀开了面罩。

sentences.en: And I saw that one looked to be in her maybe late 30s or 40s.
sentences.zh: 我看到其中一个看起来大概快四十岁或四十多岁。

sentences.en: The other one was clearly a young woman.
sentences.zh: 另一个明显是个年轻女性。

sentences.en: And I recognized her face.
sentences.zh: 我认出了她的脸。

sentences.en: Her name is
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫

sentences.en: Huda Muthana.
sentences.zh: 霍达·穆萨纳。

sentences.en: She's a young woman from Alabama, 24 years old.
sentences.zh: 她是一名来自阿拉巴马州的年轻女性，24岁。

sentences.en: She sat down next to me and I turned on my recorder.
sentences.zh: 她在我旁边坐下，我打开了录音机。

sentences.en: Can I switch with you so I can hear her better?
sentences.zh: 我能跟你换个位子以便听得更清楚吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Huda starts her story in 2014.
sentences.zh: 霍达的故事从2014年开始。

sentences.en: She says that she came from an ultra-conservative Muslim family.
sentences.zh: 她说她来自一个极端保守的穆斯林家庭。

sentences.en: She's the daughter of a Yemeni diplomat who moved to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲是一名移居美国的也门外交官。

sentences.en: She described how her mother was so strict with her that not only was she not allowed to go to
sentences.zh: 她描述了她的母亲对她有多严格，不仅不允许她去

sentences.en: parties, she didn't have a boyfriend, but she really wasn't even allowed to hang out with her
sentences.zh: 派对，不准交男朋友，甚至真的不准她跟她的

sentences.en: American friends.
sentences.zh: 美国朋友一起玩。

sentences.en: I couldn't really do anything growing up, you know?
sentences.zh: 我长大后真的什么也做不了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Couldn't do any American things.
sentences.zh: 什么美国人的活动都不能做。

sentences.en: And I'm born and raised in America.
sentences.zh: 而且我在美国出生长大。

sentences.en: I'm just as equal as an American as any blonde-haired blue-eyed cow, you know?
sentences.zh: 我和任何金发碧眼的美国人一样享有平等的权利，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I wanted to do things like them and I could never do it.
sentences.zh: 我想做像他们一样的事，但我从来没能做到。

sentences.en: And so since I was given all these restrictions, I just turned to my religion.
sentences.zh: 所以既然我受到了所有这些限制，我只能转向我的宗教。

sentences.en: Her rebellion was to turn inward to the one thing that was allowed, which was her faith, her Muslim faith.
sentences.zh: 她的叛逆是向内转向唯一被允许的事情，也就是她的信仰，她的穆斯林信仰。

sentences.en: And online, she met fellow MusliMs. There's the thing that the Muslim community on Twitter used to call like
sentences.zh: 她在网上遇到了其他穆斯林。推特上的穆斯林社区过去常常称之为

sentences.en: the Muslim Twitter sphere, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是穆斯林推特圈。

sentences.en: And I was part of it.
sentences.zh: 我是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: Muslim Twitter sphere?
sentences.zh: 穆斯林推特圈？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And she essentially became self-taught in Islam, relying on other people basically in cyberspace who were preaching an extreme form of the religion to her.
sentences.zh: 她基本上是通过自学伊斯兰教，主要依靠网络空间中向她宣讲该宗教极端形式的其他人。

sentences.en: We read verses and interpreted them ourselves and...
sentences.zh: 我们阅读经文并自己解读，然后……

sentences.en: And one of the things they convinced themselves of is that when there is a true Islamic state that
sentences.zh: 他们说服自己的事情之一就是，当一个真正的伊斯兰国被宣布建立时

sentences.en: has been declared, it is obligatory upon them to do what they call hijra, which is the pilgrimage to the state.
sentences.zh: 他们有义务进行所谓的希吉拉，也就是前往该国的朝圣。

sentences.en: I think our main focus was just thinking that it was obligatory on us to be in the caliphate.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们的主要焦点只是认为身处哈里发国对我们来说是义务。

sentences.en: I was not part of any type of jihad.
sentences.zh: 我没有参加任何形式的圣战。

sentences.en: I didn't, never shot a gun, never used any weapons or anything.
sentences.zh: 我没有，从没开过枪，从没用过任何武器之类的。

sentences.en: I literally came there because I thought it was obligatory on me.
sentences.zh: 我到那里去纯粹是因为我认为这是我的义务。

sentences.en: And I was very afraid of hell.
sentences.zh: 我非常害怕地狱。

sentences.en: Very afraid of?
sentences.zh: 非常害怕什么？

sentences.en: Of hell, yeah.
sentences.zh: 地狱，是的。

sentences.en: She was afraid that if she didn't do this, that she was somehow not following God's law.
sentences.zh: 她害怕如果她不这样做，她就是在某种程度上没有遵循上帝的法律。

sentences.en: Um, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: I thought I was doing the right thing.
sentences.zh: 我以为自己在做正确的事。

sentences.en: So what happened is that in 2014, when she was a sophomore at UAB, the University of Alabama, she essentially enrolled in her semester.
sentences.zh: 所以发生的事情是，在2014年，当她是阿拉巴马大学 UAB 的大二学生时，她基本上注册了那个学期的课程。

sentences.en: And a couple of days later, pulled out of the semester and asked for a refund check for her tuition.
sentences.zh: 几天后，她退掉了当学期的课，并要求退还学费。

sentences.en: This is tuition that her parents had paid.
sentences.zh: 这是她父母支付的学费。

sentences.en: She used that money to buy herself a plane ticket to Turkey.
sentences.zh: 她用这笔钱给自己买了一张去土耳其的机票。

sentences.en: Tell me about the night before you left.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲你离开前的那天晚上。

sentences.en: I remember just trying to act as normal as I can to my parents so that they wouldn't really think that anything was happening.
sentences.zh: 我记得只是尽量在我父母面前表现得尽可能正常，这样他们就不会真的觉得发生了什么事。

sentences.en: She lied to her parents.
sentences.zh: 她对父母撒了谎。

sentences.en: She said she was going to a university event in Atlanta a couple hours away.
sentences.zh: 她说她要去几个小时车程外的亚特兰大参加一个大学活动。

sentences.en: I left with a book bag, a heavy book bag.
sentences.zh: 我带着一个书包离开，一个沉重的书包。

sentences.en: I had just clothes and just basic travel things.
sentences.zh: 我只有衣服和基本的旅行用品。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And instead, she held a cab and went straight to the airport, flew to Turkey.
sentences.zh: 相反，她叫了一辆出租车直奔机场，飞往土耳其。

sentences.en: At what point did you call your family to tell them what had happened?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候给家人打电话告诉他们发生了什么事的？

sentences.en: I called them in Turkey before I came.
sentences.zh: 我来之前在土耳其给他们打过电话。

sentences.en: And who'd you talk to?
sentences.zh: 你跟谁说话了？

sentences.en: My sister.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐。

sentences.en: What'd you tell your sister?
sentences.zh: 你对你姐姐说了什么？

sentences.en: Just told her that I was on a trip.
sentences.zh: 只告诉她我在旅行。

sentences.en: I was on my way into the Syrian border.
sentences.zh: 我正在前往叙利亚边境的路上。

sentences.en: And did she freak out?
sentences.zh: 她吓坏了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, she freaked out.
sentences.zh: 对，她吓坏了。

sentences.en: She just screamed.
sentences.zh: 她只是尖叫。

sentences.en: And my mom started screaming.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈也开始尖叫。

sentences.en: And within, I think, a day or two, she was smuggled across the border.
sentences.zh: 我想在一两天内，她就被偷渡过了边境。

sentences.en: They smuggled us with cars.
sentences.zh: 他们用车载我们偷渡。

sentences.en: They changed the cars a few times.
sentences.zh: 他们换了几次车。

sentences.en: And then we ran through a field while I don't know which factions were shooting at us.
sentences.zh: 然后我们跑过一片田野，当时我不知道是哪个派别在向我们开枪。

sentences.en: They were shooting at you?
sentences.zh: 他们在向你们开枪？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And entered war-torn Syria.
sentences.zh: 并进入了饱受战争蹂躏的叙利亚。

sentences.en: And then after that, we were placed in a house.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们被安置在一所房子里。

sentences.en: Immediately, she's put in a dormitory for single women.
sentences.zh: 她立刻被安置在一个单身女性宿舍里。

sentences.en: She said that she arrived and it was a large house that had hundreds of women from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 她说她到达时，那是一栋住着来自世界各地的数百名女性的大房子。

sentences.en: She was the only
sentences.zh: 她是唯一的

sentences.en: American, which actually speaks to how few Americans in the end ended up joining this group.
sentences.zh: 美国人，这实际上说明了最终只有极少数美国人加入了这个组织。

sentences.en: And very quickly, she realizes that she's a prisoner.
sentences.zh: 很快，她意识到自己是个囚犯。

sentences.en: There were locks on the doors.
sentences.zh: 门上有锁。

sentences.en: There were guards outside.
sentences.zh: 外面有警卫。

sentences.en: And you're not allowed to leave the house until you get married.
sentences.zh: 在结婚之前，你是不准离开房子的。

sentences.en: It was explained to her that you're not leaving these premises until you get married.
sentences.zh: 有人向她解释说，在结婚之前，你休想离开这里。

sentences.en: Now, keep in mind, she had just turned 20 when she did this.
sentences.zh: 现在请记住，她做这件事时刚满20岁。

sentences.en: She'd never had so much as a boyfriend because her parents were so strict.
sentences.zh: 她甚至连男朋友都没交过，因为她的父母太严格了。

sentences.en: So she says that she held out for a month.
sentences.zh: 所以她说她坚持了一个月。

sentences.en: She didn't want to do it.
sentences.zh: 她不想这么做。

sentences.en: It was scary, but at the point, you just really wanted to leave that house.
sentences.zh: 这很可怕，但到了那个地步，你真的只想离开那所房子。

sentences.en: So you juSt...
sentences.zh: 所以你只...

sentences.en: There was a woman literally marrying the first man that just came to them just to get out.
sentences.zh: 有个女人为了离开，字面意义上嫁给了第一个走到她面前的男人。

sentences.en: Every day, there was an ISIS official who was walking around the dorm with a list of eligible bachelors inside the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 每天都有一个 ISIS 官员拿着伊斯兰国内符合条件的光棍名单在宿舍里四处走动。

sentences.en: These were fighters that were looking for brides.
sentences.zh: 这些都是在寻找新娘的战士。

sentences.en: You just write your preferences down and then some guy comes with a list of men and you can choose any of them.
sentences.zh: 你只要写下你的偏好，然后就会有人拿着一份男人的名单来，你可以从中选择任何人。

sentences.en: And then you just have a meeting with them.
sentences.zh: 然后你跟他们见个面。

sentences.en: And if you like him, then you get married.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢他，你们就结婚。

sentences.en: In the end, she said that when a girlfriend of hers who was in the same dorm proposed an Australian man that she happened to know, she agreed to meet him.
sentences.zh: 最后她说，当她同宿舍的一个女性朋友向她推荐一个她恰好认识的澳大利亚男人时，她同意去见他。

sentences.en: They met with a chaperone.
sentences.zh: 他们在陪伴下见面。

sentences.en: They spoke for really just a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上只谈了几分钟。

sentences.en: And then she let him take her home.
sentences.zh: 然后她让他带她回家。

sentences.en: Look, I mean, you said that Hoda had held out, which is kind of confusing.
sentences.zh: 听着，我的意思是，你说过霍达坚持住了，这有点让人困惑。

sentences.en: Did she not know?
sentences.zh: 难道她不知道吗？

sentences.en: That this was what was expected of women who joined the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 这就是对加入伊斯兰国的女性的期望。

sentences.en: Isn't that kind of part of the deal?
sentences.zh: 这难道不是交易的一部分吗？

sentences.en: I asked her the same question because I was reading up on the Islamic State at the same time that she was going there.
sentences.zh: 我问了她同样的问题，因为我在她去那里的同时也在阅读关于伊斯兰国的资料。

sentences.en: And it was pretty clear to me from the things that other women inside ISIS were posting that this is what happens.
sentences.zh: 从 ISIS 内部其他女性发布的内容来看，我很清楚这就是会发生的事情。

sentences.en: And she said, I did, but I thought there was a way out.
sentences.zh: 她说，我知道，但我以为有出路。

sentences.en: I thought I could just talk my way out or something.
sentences.zh: 我以为我可以凭三寸不烂之舌说通并离开或者别的什么。

sentences.en: And I think in the moment she gets there, filled with this religious fervor, thinking that she has now come to fulfill her faith.
sentences.zh: 我想在她抵达的那一刻，她充满了这种宗教狂热，认为自己现在是为了履行信仰而来。

sentences.en: And then these other things were vexing things that she had to go through in the journey to that faith.
sentences.zh: 然后这些其他事情是她在通往该信仰的旅程中必须经历的烦恼。

sentences.en: And what was the marriage ceremony like?
sentences.zh: 婚礼仪式是什么样的？

sentences.en: No, you just go to the court and you get paper signed and that's it, you're married.
sentences.zh: 没有，你只要去法院签个字就行了，就这样，你们结婚了。

sentences.en: She marries this Australian man.
sentences.zh: 她嫁给了这个澳大利亚男人。

sentences.en: He is killed three months after they get married.
sentences.zh: 他们在结婚三个月后他就被杀了。

sentences.en: So now you're a widowed woman inside the caliphate.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你是哈里发国内的一个寡妇。

sentences.en: What happened to you at this point?
sentences.zh: 这时候你发生了什么事？

sentences.en: It was the first of three arranged marriages.
sentences.zh: 这是三次包办婚姻中的第一次。

sentences.en: After that, you either go back to the malafa, to the house, or you get married again, or you just stay on your own.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，要么你回 malafa，也就是那个房子，要么你再结婚，要么你就自己呆着。

sentences.en: And if you're on your own, really, you don't get much rights.
sentences.zh: 如果你自己呆着，说实话，你不会得到什么权利。

sentences.en: She was really embarrassed about this.
sentences.zh: 她对此感到非常尴尬。

sentences.en: She asked me at one point, could you not publish that I had been married three times?
sentences.zh: 她曾在某个时候问我，能不能不要把我结过三次婚的事情公之于众？

sentences.en: And I asked her why.
sentences.zh: 我问她为什么。

sentences.en: And she said, my mom doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 她说，我妈妈不知道。

sentences.en: I've been married many times.
sentences.zh: 我结过很多次婚。

sentences.en: I've been married three times, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我结过三次婚。

sentences.en: And my mom doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈都不知道。

sentences.en: My mom doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈不知道。

sentences.en: And what does she tell you about what day-to-day life was like inside the caliphate?
sentences.zh: 那她对你讲述过哈里发国境内的日常生活是怎样的吗？

sentences.en: She's basically a housewife.
sentences.zh: 她基本上就是个家庭主妇。

sentences.en: She's at home, unable to really leave the premises of the house because women are not allowed outside without a male guardian.
sentences.zh: 她呆在家里面，根本无法离开房屋的范围，因为女性没有男性监护人陪伴是不得外出的。

sentences.en: And so she describes a life of boredom.
sentences.zh: 所以她形容那是一种无聊的生活。

sentences.en: But in fact, this is where I know that she's not telling me the full truth.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，也就是在这里，我知道她没有对我说实话。

sentences.en: We have her Twitter feed.
sentences.zh: 我们有她的推特动态。

sentences.en: And she was posting hateful incitements, calling for attacks in the West, trying to encourage other Westerners to join the Islamic state.
sentences.zh: 她发布充满仇恨的煽动言论，呼吁在西方发动袭击，试图鼓励其他西方人加入伊斯兰国。

sentences.en: For example, in January of 2015, she had already been in the Islamic state for a couple of months.
sentences.zh: 例如，在2015年1月，她加入伊斯兰国其实才几个月。

sentences.en: She puts out a tweet where she's making fun of Americans who are sitting at home and refusing to come.
sentences.zh: 她发了一条推文，嘲笑那些坐在家里、拒绝前来的人美国人。

sentences.en: She says, there are so many Aussies and Brits here, but where are the Americans?
sentences.zh: 她说，这里有那么多的澳大利亚人和英国人，但美国人在哪里？

sentences.en: Wake up, you cowards.
sentences.zh: 醒醒吧，你们这群懦夫。

sentences.en: And then more disturbingly, a couple of months later, we're now in March of 2015.
sentences.zh: 更令人不安的是，几个月后，时间来到了2015年3月。

sentences.en: She writes, Americans, wake up.
sentences.zh: 她写道，美国人，醒醒吧。

sentences.en: You have much to do while you live under our greatest enemy.
sentences.zh: 生活在我们最大的敌人统治下，你们还有很多事要做。

sentences.en: Enough of your sleeping.
sentences.zh: 别再睡了。

sentences.en: Go on drive-by's and spill all of their blood or rent a big truck and drive all over them.
sentences.zh: 去搞车上枪击，洒满他们的血，或者租一辆大卡车把他们统统碾过去。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So she's explicitly calling.
sentences.zh: 所以她是在公开呼吁。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Explicitly calling for attacks in America.
sentences.zh: 公开呼吁在美国发动袭击。

sentences.en: So she wasn't just a housewife.
sentences.zh: 所以她不仅仅是个家庭主妇。

sentences.en: She was a mouthpiece for this terrorist group.
sentences.zh: 她是这个恐怖组织的喉舌。

sentences.en: She told me that she first began to question her reasons for being there two years after she had arrived.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她到达两年后，才开始质疑自己留在那里的原因。

sentences.en: So she comes in late 2014.
sentences.zh: 所以她是2014年底来的。

sentences.en: That puts us in late 2016.
sentences.zh: 那也就是2016年底。

sentences.en: And what caused her to question this was something quite personal.
sentences.zh: 而让她产生这种质疑的原因是一件非常私人的事情。

sentences.en: I was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我怀孕了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Very emotional.
sentences.zh: 非常情绪化。

sentences.en: Missed my family.
sentences.zh: 很想念我的家人。

sentences.en: And I just really thought it over.
sentences.zh: 我真的仔细想了想。

sentences.en: Really thought, like, what am I doing?
sentences.zh: 真的在想，我到底在干什么？

sentences.en: And that is the beginning of a transformation where she begins to think, this is not the place where I want to see my child grow up.
sentences.zh: 那是她转变的开始，她开始思考，这里并不是我想让我的孩子长大的地方。

sentences.en: It's horrifying.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: Everything is horrifying.
sentences.zh: 一切都太可怕了。

sentences.en: You see executions in the street.
sentences.zh: 你会在街上看到行刑。

sentences.en: You see dead bodies everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你到处都能看到尸体。

sentences.en: You hear bombs.
sentences.zh: 你能听到炸弹声。

sentences.en: You hear someone screaming.
sentences.zh: 你能听到有人在尖叫。

sentences.en: You can't go out and help them.
sentences.zh: 你不能出去帮他们。

sentences.en: For fear of your own life.
sentences.zh: 因为害怕你自己的生命受到威胁。

sentences.en: Screaming to death, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是活活尖叫致死。

sentences.en: And you can't do anything.
sentences.zh: 而你什么也做不了。

sentences.en: It's very traumatizing.
sentences.zh: 这极具创伤性。

sentences.en: Actually, since we're here in the camps and we just hear a car passing by, we just ducked down because of how afraid you are.
sentences.zh: 其实，既然我们现在在营地里，只要听到有车开过，我们就会立刻蹲下来，因为你太害怕了。

sentences.en: She claims that she couldn't run away.
sentences.zh: 她声称自己无法逃跑。

sentences.en: They put IABs in the ground so that if people try to escape, they'll just be blown up.
sentences.zh: 他们在地下埋了简易爆炸装置，如果有人试图逃跑，就会被炸飞。

sentences.en: Running away was very difficult.
sentences.zh: 逃跑非常困难。

sentences.en: If you were caught, you were severely punished, possibly imprisoned, and even killed.
sentences.zh: 如果你被抓到，就会受到严厉惩罚，甚至可能被关进监狱，乃至丧命。

sentences.en: Keep in mind, at this point in time, ISIS's territory is quickly shrinking.
sentences.zh: 请记住，在那个时候，伊斯兰国的领土正在迅速萎缩。

sentences.en: And so Hoda finds herself moving from house to house, essentially chasing the receding shadow of the caliphate.
sentences.zh: 因此，霍达发现自己不得不从一个房子搬到另一个房子，基本上是在追逐哈里发国那逐渐消逝的阴影。

sentences.en: Moving from houses to houses because there was a lot of moving going on from moms and stuff.
sentences.zh: 从一个房子搬到另一个房子，因为妈妈们之类的人一直在频繁搬迁。

sentences.en: When Raqqa falls, she is forced to move to the town of Mayadeen.
sentences.zh: 拉卡沦陷后，她被迫搬到了迈亚丁镇。

sentences.en: When Mayadeen falls, she moves to a village called Hajin.
sentences.zh: 迈亚丁沦陷后，她搬到了一个叫哈金的村庄。

sentences.en: From Hajin, she's taken to the village of Shafa.
sentences.zh: 从哈金，她被带到了沙法村。

sentences.en: And at that point, she ends up in the very last pocket of ISIS's territorial control in the region.
sentences.zh: 在那时，她最终落脚于伊斯兰国在该地区控制的最后一片领地。

sentences.en: And it's there that she befriends another American woman.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，她结识了另一位美国女性。

sentences.en: Let me switch to you while we have still a little bit of time left.
sentences.zh: 趁我们还有一点时间，我把话题转回你这里。

sentences.en: I'm just going to go over there.
sentences.zh: 我这就走过去。

sentences.en: And who is this other American woman that Hoda becomes close to?
sentences.zh: 霍达与之亲近的这位美国女性是谁？

sentences.en: So, you're from Hamilton?
sentences.zh: 所以，你来自汉密尔顿？

sentences.en: Her name is Kimberly Gwen Pullman.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫金伯利·格温·普尔曼。

sentences.en: And I have to say, having covered this group for the past five years now, her story is pretty weird.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，过去五年我一直在报道这个组织，她的故事相当离奇。

sentences.en: What's your date of birth?
sentences.zh: 你的出生日期是？

Kimberly is a white woman who is an American-Canadian dual national.
sentences.zh: 金伯利是一名拥有美加双重国籍的白人女性。

sentences.zh: 你来自一个基督教家庭吗？

sentences.zh: 我来自一个完全的基督教家庭。

sentences.en: Very much so.
sentences.zh: 非常虔诚。

sentences.zh: 荷兰裔。

sentences.zh: 归正会。

sentences.zh: 斜杠门诺会。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So you come from a really conservative background?
sentences.zh: 所以你来自一个非常保守的背景？

sentences.en: Quite, yes.
sentences.zh: 相当保守，是的。

sentences.en: She was born into a Mennonite Christian community.
sentences.zh: 她出生于一个门诺会基督教社区。

sentences.en: My grandfather was a minister.
sentences.zh: 我祖父是一名牧师。

sentences.en: My father was a doctor until he died.
sentences.zh: 我父亲生前是一名医生。

sentences.en: And at some point in her adult life, she converted to Islam.
sentences.zh: 在她成年后的某个时候，她皈依了伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: I had time to spend online.
sentences.zh: 我有时间上网。

sentences.en: I was stuck in bed basically.
sentences.zh: 我基本上被困在床上。

sentences.en: According to her family, she was struggling with some form of mental illness.
sentences.zh: 据她的家人说，她当时正在与某种形式的精神疾病作斗争。

sentences.en: And it was during that time that my Facebook was just flooded with pictures of what was happening at Gaza.
sentences.zh: 正是在那段时间里，我的脸书上铺天盖地都是加沙发生的事情的照片。

sentences.en: By 2014, she had also gone down this online rabbit hole.
sentences.zh: 到2014年，她也陷入了这种网络迷局之中。

sentences.en: And then, of course, Syria was ongoing during this time, and that was just stepping up more and more and more.
sentences.zh: 当然，当时叙利亚战事正在进行，而且那种情况越来越激烈。

sentences.en: And she made a decision in 2015 to follow a man she had met online into the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 她在2015年做出决定，跟随一个她在网上认识的男人加入了伊斯兰国。

sentences.en: He said, come where you're loved.
sentences.zh: 他说，来吧，这里有人爱护你。

sentences.en: Come where you're actually needed.
sentences.zh: 来吧，这里真正需要你。

sentences.en: They don't need you over there.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里不需要你。

sentences.en: We need you over here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里需要你。

sentences.en: You have skills.
sentences.zh: 你有一技之长。

sentences.en: Where she, too, became ensnared in the same system as Hoda.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她也像霍达一样陷入了同样的系统之中。

sentences.en: Unlike Hoda, she describes a much more rapid realization that she had made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 与霍达不同的是，她形容自己更快地意识到自己犯了错误。

sentences.en: She said that within a couple of months of being there, she tried to escape.
sentences.zh: 她说，去那儿几个月内，她就试图逃跑。

sentences.en: She was very quickly caught by ISIS's intelligence service.
sentences.zh: 她很快就被伊斯兰国的情报部门抓住了。

sentences.en: They took her to a prison.
sentences.zh: 他们把她带到了一所监狱。

sentences.en: She was held there for some time, and then she faced the violent punishment that they meted out to her to scare her into submission.
sentences.zh: 她在那里被关押了一段时间，然后他们对她施以暴力惩罚，以吓唬她使其屈服。

sentences.en: And what was that punishment?
sentences.zh: 那是什么惩罚？

sentences.en: They raped her.
sentences.zh: 他们强奸了她。

sentences.en: They raped her in retaliation for her attempted escape.
sentences.zh: 为了报复她试图逃跑，他们强奸了她。

sentences.en: What they did just ripped everything wide open to the point where I no longer wanted to even survive anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们所做的一切彻底击溃了我，以至于我甚至连活下去的念头都没有了。

sentences.en: And I'd become suicidal.
sentences.zh: 我产生了自杀倾向。

sentences.en: It scared the heck out of her.
sentences.zh: 这把她吓坏了。

sentences.en: If her account is true, and I have no way of fact-checking these things that happened deep inside the caliphate, but if her account is true, it explains why she would hold on until
sentences.zh: 如果她的说法属实，而且我也没有办法去核实这些发生在哈里发国腹地的事情，但如果她的说法属实，那就解释了她为什么会坚持到

sentences.en: the very, very end.
sentences.zh: 最后的最末端。

sentences.en: And it's at the end of the caliphate when you said that she and Hoda become quite close.
sentences.zh: 正是在哈里发国走向终结的时候，你提到她和霍达变得非常亲密。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They become close.
sentences.zh: 她们变得很亲密。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So in this last pocket of ISIS control, they are basically squatting in tents and just trying to survive.
sentences.zh: 所以在伊斯兰国控制的最后这片区域，她们基本上是蹲在帐篷里，艰难求生。

sentences.en: The bomb's dropping 24-7.
sentences.zh: 炸弹24小时不停地落下。

sentences.en: They described to me how there was almost no food.
sentences.zh: 她们向我描述了几乎没有食物的情况。

sentences.en: No food.
sentences.zh: 没有食物。

sentences.en: For the last month, we were eating cow food and grass.
sentences.zh: 最后一个月，我们靠吃牛饲料和草度日。

sentences.en: At one point, they were cutting grass from the crevices in the pavement and boiling it to eat.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，她们割开路面缝隙里的草，煮着吃。

sentences.en: No diapers.
sentences.zh: 没有尿布。

sentences.en: Medical system.
sentences.zh: 医疗系统。

sentences.en: No medicine.
sentences.zh: 没有药。

sentences.en: If you have two diapers, what did you put on them?
sentences.zh: 如果你只有两片尿布，你是怎么给他们用的？

sentences.en: Towels.
sentences.zh: 毛巾。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But Kimberly, you trusted her.
sentences.zh: 但金伯利，你信任她。

sentences.en: I trusted her.
sentences.zh: 我信任她。

sentences.en: They begin to trust each other.
sentences.zh: 她们开始信任彼此。

sentences.en: Because, of course, both of them at this point want to escape.
sentences.zh: 因为当然，此时她们俩都想逃跑。

sentences.en: But that's a very precarious thing to be sharing with somebody else inside the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 但在伊斯兰国内部，与其他人分享这种想法是一件非常危险的事。

sentences.en: They eventually shared it with each other.
sentences.zh: 她们最终向彼此坦白了这一点。

sentences.en: The day before I left, I saw her and I said, I need to leave today.
sentences.zh: 我离开的前一天，我见到了她，我对她说，我今天必须离开。

sentences.en: This is my last day in here.
sentences.zh: 这是我在这里的最后一天了。

sentences.en: I need to go now.
sentences.zh: 我现在必须走。

sentences.en: And with each other's help, they began plotting this escape.
sentences.zh: 在彼此的帮助下，她们开始策划这场逃亡。

sentences.en: And then Hoda got out firSt.
sentences.zh: 然后霍达先逃出去了。

sentences.en: So it got dark and we lost our way.
sentences.zh: 天黑了，我们迷了路。

sentences.en: And we had to wait till the morning.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不等到早晨。

sentences.en: I just ran for my life, basically.
sentences.zh: 我基本上就是为了保命而狂奔。

sentences.en: She got into the desert to the screening point where American forces are waiting for ISIS members who are surrendering.
sentences.zh: 她逃进了沙漠中的筛查点，美军正是在那里等待投降的伊斯兰国成员。

sentences.en: She says that the Americans fingerprinted her.
sentences.zh: 她说美国人提取了她的指纹。

sentences.en: And Kimberly came out the next day or a few days later.
sentences.zh: 金伯利在第二天或几天后出来了。

sentences.en: And so that's how Hoda and Kimberly end up at this detention facility that you visit.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么霍达和金伯利最终会来到你参观的那座拘留中心。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is the place where they are taking, by now, the thousands of people that have streamed out into the desert.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们现在关押成千上万从沙漠中涌出的人的地方。

sentences.en: This is where they're taking them.
sentences.zh: 这里就是他们关押这些人的地方。

sentences.en: And in this camp, they're being triaged into ISIS members, ISIS families, ISIS children.
sentences.zh: 在这个营地里，他们被分流筛选，分为伊斯兰国成员、伊斯兰国家属和伊斯兰国儿童。

sentences.en: And in this camp, they are essentially prisoners.
sentences.zh: 在这个营地里，他们基本上就是囚犯。

sentences.en: They're able to move between the tents, but they're not able to go beyond the chain link fence.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在帐篷之间走动，但不能跨越铁丝网。

sentences.en: And what do these two women tell you, now that they are out of the Islamic State and in this facility, that they want?
sentences.zh: 那么，这两名女性既然已经离开了伊斯兰国并来到了这个设施，她们告诉你她们想要什么？

sentences.en: What are they hoping for?
sentences.zh: 她们期望得到什么？

sentences.en: Both of them expressed what they said was sincere regret for having joined this group.
sentences.zh: 两人都表达了她们所说的加入这个组织的真诚悔意。

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: I went from having no knowledge to just going on Twitter, reading a few posts, and just sacrificing my whole life.
sentences.zh: 我从一无所知，到只是刷推特、读了几篇帖子，就把我整个人生都搭进去了。

sentences.en: And once I look back at it, I just can't stress how much of a crazy idea that was.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，我简直无法强调那是多么疯狂的一个想法。

sentences.en: I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: I ruined my life.
sentences.zh: 我毁了我的人生。

sentences.en: I ruined my future.
sentences.zh: 我毁了我的未来。

sentences.en: Both of them repeatedly said that they're very sorry for having joined ISIS, for the things they had said previously.
sentences.zh: 两人都一再表示，对于加入伊斯兰国以及以前说过的话，她们感到非常抱歉。

sentences.en: I don't have words for how much regret I have.
sentences.zh: 我无法用言语表达我有多后悔。

sentences.en: I wish that I could turn back the time.
sentences.zh: 我希望时光能够倒流。

sentences.en: I wish I could have seen.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能看清这一切。

sentences.en: And I wish I had been a lot more knowledgeable and that I hadn't listened.
sentences.zh: 我希望自己当时能更有见识，没有去听信那些话。

sentences.en: And both of them are essentially begging the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且两人基本上都在恳求美国

sentences.en: government to take them back.
sentences.zh: 政府接纳她们回去。

sentences.en: I know this is more personal things, but we really want to stress.
sentences.zh: 我知道这更偏向个人私事，但我们真的很想强调这一点。

sentences.en: We want to come back and we're not a threat and we just regret everything.
sentences.zh: 我们想回去，我们不是威胁，我们对一切都深感后悔。

sentences.en: I will check it erased the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我会检查它是否把整件事都抹掉了。

sentences.en: And Rukmini, do you believe them when they say that they are full of regret?
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，当她们说自己充满悔意时，你相信她们吗？

sentences.en: Look, it is convenient that they only managed to escape essentially in the last couple of weeks of the territorial caliphate in Iraq and Syria.
sentences.zh: 听着，她们偏偏在伊拉克和叙利亚的领地哈里发国存在的最后几周才设法逃出来，这未免太巧了。

sentences.en: I'm curious what the context is for this.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道这背后的背景是什么。

sentences.en: What have countries like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 像美国这样的国家

sentences.en: done with ISIS members who have tried to come home in the past?
